sections.title: Plant and tubers
sections.text: The plate depicts the potato, Solanum tuberosum: a herb up to about 1 m tall with divided leaves, star-shaped flowers and underground stem tubers. Flowers are about 2.5 cm across; the edible tubers vary greatly by cultivar.

sections.title: Food and toxicity
sections.text: Cooked tubers are a staple food. Green tubers and other green parts contain elevated glycoalkaloids, including solanine, and should not be eaten; the green berries are also inedible. The tubers are stems, not roots.
